articles.title: Maharashtra Revises PUC Charges; Two-Wheelers To Pay ₹60, Diesel Vehicles Face Highest Charge Of ₹180
articles.description: Maharashtra has revised Pollution Under Control certificate testing charges, with two-wheelers now paying Rs 60, petrol three-wheelers Rs 120, petrol/CNG/LPG vehicles Rs 140 and diesel vehicles Rs 180. PUC centres have been directed to display the revised rates and avoid charging motorists above the prescribed amounts.

articles.title: Sweet dilemma : Ethanol ambitions face sugar reality
articles.description: INDIA’s decision to allow the duty-free import of 10 lakh tonnes of raw sugar is more than a response to soaring prices; it is a reality check for its ambitious ethanol policy. Less than two years after celebrating the nationwide rollout of E20 petrol, the government now finds itself balancing two competing imperatives — reducing oil imports and ensuring affordable sugar for consumers. The episode underscores a classic policy dilemma: when food and fuel compete for the same crop, neither objective can be pursued in isolation.

articles.title: Assam-Meghalaya tensions: 5 CAPF companies deployed
articles.description: The Centre has approved the deployment of five companies of central armed police forces in Meghalaya following the violent protests in Shillong that left several people injured and vehicles damaged. A senior police official said, "A petrol bomb was hurled at a police outpost in Shillong, while three government vehicles and a motorcycle were set ablaze in Ri-Bhoi and another petrol bomb was lobbed at a government office in Southwest Khasi Hills. There are reports of petrol bombs being hurled at the ruling National People's Party office in Shillong. No one has been injured."

articles.title: US equity funds see strong inflows this week amid bond pressure, draw $11.72 billion from investors
articles.description: US investors bought equities for a second week, encouraged by corporate earnings and easing inflation. Bond funds saw significant inflows, while money market funds experienced outflows.
